description: Synthetic fixtures for interface development. No real samples, clinical metadata, or research measurements.

state_definitions.observed: A simulated measurement is available. Zero is a valid observed value.
state_definitions.not_measured: This feature/channel was not measured in this simulated sample.
state_definitions.failed: A simulated processing failure; no measurement is available.
state_definitions.low_depth: A simulated depth threshold was not met; the displayed measurement is unavailable.
